scope.module_policy: Only module checks mapped to CVE-2025-53772, CVE-2025-27473, CVE-2025-59282, and CVE-2025-59287 are loaded. Legacy IIS hardening modules are removed.
scope.execution_mode: local USB audit: msfrpc check/probe plus PowerShell patch/service checks
notes: CVE-2025-53772 and CVE-2025-27473 use safe Metasploit HTTP fingerprint probes unless a custom scanner with the configured path is installed.
CVE-2025-59282 is local-only because no Metasploit module is configured.
CVE-2025-59287 is an exploit module and must be executed with the Metasploit check command only.

common_http_options.UserAgent: Mozilla/5.0 VulnMngSys IIS authorized CVE scanner

common_https_options.UserAgent: Mozilla/5.0 VulnMngSys IIS authorized CVE scanner

modules.name: CVE-2025-53772 Web Deploy RCE check
modules.server_2022_relevance: Checks local Web Deploy / WMSvc exposure and patch posture on Windows Server 2022+.

local_check.patch_guidance: Install the Microsoft Web Deploy / IIS cumulative update that remediates CVE-2025-53772.

modules.expected_signal: Reports Web Deploy endpoint reachability, deserialization/BinaryFormatter findings, and local Web Deploy patch state.

modules.name: CVE-2025-27473 HTTP.sys DoS check
modules.server_2022_relevance: Checks local HTTP.sys/IIS listeners and April 2025 or later patch posture.

local_check.patch_guidance: Install the April 2025 or later Windows Server cumulative update that remediates CVE-2025-27473.

modules.expected_signal: Reports HTTP.sys/IIS fingerprinting, resource exhaustion indicators, and local HTTP.sys patch state.

modules.name: CVE-2025-59282 Inbox COM Objects race condition check
modules.server_2022_relevance: Checks October 2025 or later patch posture and selected COM library versions on the local host.

local_check.patch_guidance: Install the October 2025 or later Windows Server cumulative update that remediates CVE-2025-59282.

modules.expected_signal: Reports local patch and COM DLL version posture; no Metasploit module is required.

modules.name: CVE-2025-59287 WSUS deserialization RCE check
modules.server_2022_relevance: Checks local WSUS HTTP/HTTPS endpoints in Metasploit check mode and verifies local WSUS patch/service posture.

local_check.patch_guidance: Install the October 2025 or later Windows Server cumulative update and WSUS update that remediates CVE-2025-59287.

modules.expected_signal: Reports vulnerable/check output for GetCookie, AuthorizationCookie, BinaryFormatter, and local WSUS patch state.

excluded_or_dangerous_modules.reason: Removed from focused 2025 CVE profile; active write tests are not part of this audit.

pymetasploit3_runner_template.description: Load each module via msfrpc, override target/port options, run auxiliary modules with run and exploit modules with check.
pseudo_code: for k, v in default_datastore.items(): mod[k] = v
